image_description: A large sturgeon lying on a gravelly shore, partially in shallow water. A human hand and arm are visible holding the fish near the head. The fish has a long, pointed snout, visible barbels, and rows of bony scutes along its back. The tail is visible but partially obscured by the angle and water.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Elongated head with protrusible mouth on ventral surface.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The head is clearly elongated and the mouth position appears consistent with ventral placement, though the exact mouth opening is slightly obscured by the hand/gravel.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Four barbels (sensory whiskers) anterior to mouth.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: At least two barbels are clearly visible hanging down from the snout area; the presence of four is biologically standard and consistent with the visible structures, though not all four are perfectly distinct due to resolution/angle.
The snout is distinctly pointed and elongated, matching the sturgeon morphology.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Elongated fusiform body with impressively large, extended proportions.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The body is long, cylindrical, and tapers towards the tail, fitting the fusiform description.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Five rows of bony scutes (plates) along body instead of scales.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Distinct rows of raised, bony plates (scutes) are clearly visible running longitudinally along the dorsal and lateral aspects of the fish. No typical fish scales are visible.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Gray, brown, or black dorsally with lighter ventral surface.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The dorsal side is dark gray/brown, and the visible underside near the head appears lighter, consistent with counter-shading.
The tail fin is visible at the far left; the upper lobe appears larger than the lower lobe, characteristic of a heterocercal tail, although the tip is slightly cut off by the frame.

artifact_observations.reasoning: The human hand holding the fish exhibits slight smudging and lack of fine skin detail. The sleeve texture blends somewhat unnaturally into the background, suggesting minor generation artifacts or compression issues common in AI-generated human limbs.
The very tip of the tail fin seems to dissolve slightly into the water/background rather than having a sharp edge, indicating minor boundary definition issues.
